A '''[[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Wode]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It had a gravitational pull twice that of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard.

==Behind the scenes==
The unlicensed&mdash;and thus non-canon&mdash; magazine article "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]" attributes the [[Wode system]] to [[Brian Daley]]'s ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'' which was the first source to mention the [[Wode]] species.<ref name="HSR" />, and places the system in [[Mahrusha sector]].<ref name="VSF13">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>
